name: CodeQA
description: We propose CodeQA, a free-form question answering dataset for the purpose of source code comprehension: given a code snippet and a question, a textual answer is required to be generated. CodeQA contains a Java dataset with 119,778 question-answer pairs and a Python dataset with 70,085 question-answer pairs. To obtain natural and faithful questions and answers, we implement syntactic rules and semantic analysis to transform code comments into question-answer pairs.
reputation: A large code comprehension QA dataset that has been used in source-code understanding research, though it is less widely standardized than major code benchmarks.
notes: Derived from code comments and synthetic QA generation, so it may contain artifacts; evaluation is typically string-based and the benchmark is not as commonly tracked as newer code LLM leaderboards.
